This page lists foods that can be crafted on the [[#Cooking Table|cooking table]], in the [[#Oven|oven]], or on a [[#Bonfire|bonfire]]. The recipes first have to be unlocked. See [[Cookery (Tech Tree)|here]] for more details.

== Cooking Table ==
[[File:cooking table.gif|left|200px|This is how the cooking table looks]]
The cooking table cannot be built and is unlocked from the beginning of the game. 

Unlike the oven, the cooking table mostly produces '''food components''', which can be used for more complicated meals. A few items are cold dishes and can be eaten directly. Even some non-food items like [[Ceramic funeral urn|urns]] can be crafted here.

The cooking table has 2 skins, normal and updated.
{{clear}}

Normal skin: {{Item|flitch|4}}, {{Item|Nails|6}}, {{Item|Simple iron parts|3}}

Updated skin {{Item|wooden plank|4}}, {{Item|Nails|6}}, {{Item|complex iron parts|3}}
{{clear}}

== Professional Kitchen (DLC)  ==
[[File:Professional kitchen.png|left|200px|This is how the professional kitchen looks]]
The Professional Kitchen is located in the [[Talking Skull Cellar]] which is in the basement of the [[Talking Skull]]. Food created here will be placed into the [[Barman]]'s inventory to be sold during [[Talking Skull#Tavern Events|Tavern Events]].
{{Clear}}

== Oven ==
[[File:Oven.gif|left|200px|This is how an oven looks]]
The oven is found in your [[Sweet Home|home]] and is where you will do most of the cooking in the game.  The oven is one of few [[Work Stations|work stations]] which cannot be constructed.

'''Note:''' To use the [[oven]] for cooking, you have to [[fuel]] it in advance. The oven prepares food in a few seconds (the numbers are real world time in seconds). You can use batch production to order several meals in one turn.

Some food can be crafted at 3 quality levels. Copper{{Quality|copper}}, silver{{Quality|silver}}, and gold{{Quality|gold}} stars. They yield different {{energy}} amounts when consumed.
{{clear}}

== Professional Oven (DLC)  ==
[[File:Professional oven.png|left|200px|This is how a professional oven looks]]
The Professional Oven is located in the [[Talking Skull Cellar]] which is in the basement of the [[Talking Skull]]. Food created here will be placed into the [[Barman]]'s inventory to be sold during [[Talking Skull#Tavern Events|Tavern Events]].

'''Note:''' To use the Professional Oven for cooking, you have to [[fuel]] it in advance. The oven prepares food in a few seconds (the numbers are real world time in seconds). You can use batch production to order several meals at a time.

Some food can be crafted at 3 quality levels. Copper{{Quality|copper}}, silver{{Quality|silver}}, and gold{{Quality|gold}} stars. They yield different [[effects]] and {{energy}} amounts when consumed.
{{clear}}

[[File:Bonfire.png|left|200px|A bonfire at night]]
